Desireing is fine, just turn the forfilment object from another to you being the fulfiller. think of everybody has  their issues, whatever they even be. feelings are just body reaction to hormone, wanting something to make you feel, means you want another unrelated thing to give ur body permission to secrete hormone that make u feel that whatever. as u can see, nobody can squeeze ur body to secret feelings but only u can to you, so why want permision from another? why not be the one u seek the one to give you permission? sure in beginning it would feel strange but few months ud be used to it and somewhat better at it, spend time with u, be or pretend to be the partner u seek, imgine, act pretend, at some point all will merge, en when u do endup in external relationship u wont seek much from them, at very least their presence would be enough mostly because theyd be more like en extra to u than main, as you would be holding that part of destiny in ur hands. lol partners wont like that so be considerate of them, look back en remember what u once desired from partner before u married ur self en became that partner u yearned at that time, certain things cant be given by others so dont try to fill their void but help them fill it themselves much they are wiling to. 

dont mean ull have perfect or lasting relationships but eatleast u wont yearn too much en it will decrease as you get more perfect partner to you. You will likely suffer from partners thinking u are disinterested in them. So try ur best to fulfil them but have limit, certain things others have to do it themselves, u will realise how unwilling people are even if their way is bringing them failure en suffering.
